text: MCP client can create and modify native Figma content directly on the canvas

text: Select a Figma frame and generate code from it via MCP

text: Pull variables, components, and layout data into an IDE for design-system work

text: Multiple people can edit the same file simultaneously with live cursors and instant sync

text: Plugins can automate tasks and add new functionality across workflows

text: Get summary counts of how many instances of a library's components exist across all files
